text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Metering pipeline anomaly detected — heartbeat missing from shard-3 for ~12m. Ingestion lag >5m. Risk: delayed usage reports and possible provisional overage flags being sent. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/metering/heartbeat-lag :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): ack, picking this up. paging kira (secondary). @kira you up? :eyes:

kira (oncall): I'm up and looking. any obvious customer-facing errors yet?

maria (oncall): billing dashboard shows delayed per-account usage; a couple of accounts got provisional overage alerts – likely noise. example acct_3392: 0 tokens for last 10m while traffic exists. logs indicate consumer offsets stalling on reconnects.

samir (billing): looking into the consumer logs. I see checkpoint commits failing intermittently and when it reconnects we get duplicated window counts — looks like ~2-3% duplication in reconnect windows. recent consumer-lib bump to v2.3.1 touched checkpoint logic.

kira (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause aggregation consumer for shard-3, 2) pause overage webhook notifications, 3) enable fallback aggregator, 4) run audit compare. Maria can you pause shard-3 consumer?

maria (oncall): pausing shard-3 now...

maria (oncall): ```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deployment metering-aggregator-shard-3 --replicas=0
```

maria (oncall): scaled to 0; give it 30s to quiesce.

incident-bot: status update: mitigation in progress (auto-update in 5m).

leo (sre): while we pause, block firing of billing overage webhooks to reduce noise to customers.

leo (sre): ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/alerts/overage/pause -d '{"shard":"shard-3","until":"1h"}'
```

samir (billing): running audit compare now to quantify duplication:

samir (billing): ```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_seen, SUM(tokens_fallback) AS tokens_fallback
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY tokens_seen DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

samir (billing): first-pass shows ~2.8% duplication concentrated around reconnect windows. I'm going to rollback consumer-lib to v2.2.9 for shard-3 as a canary.

kira (oncall): agree with rollback. maria, please patch the deployment image to the v2.2.9 canary.

maria (oncall): ```bash
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/metering-aggregator-shard-3 aggregator=billing/consumer:v2.2.9-canary
```

maria (oncall): patched. watching logs...

maria (oncall): ```
metering-agg[stdout] INFO checkpoint commit success seq=482391
metering-agg[stdout] INFO processed 12000 tokens window=30s
```

maria (oncall): no duplicates observed after reconnect in the next 2m. dashboard lag is decreasing. :white_check_mark:

kira (oncall): nice work. Customer impact summary for CS: delayed usage reports for the last ~15m, potential provisional overage alerts suppressed; final charges will normalize after audit. @cs_reachout can you draft an outbound note with ETA?

cs_reachout: On it — drafting now, will post to #customer-success for review.

incident-bot: mitigation complete for shard-3; monitoring window set to 30m. Severity downgraded to P3. Tagging for post-incident review.

juan (oncall): taking handoff. Actions noted: rolled back consumer for shard-3, paused overage webhooks, audit query saved. I'll keep watch for an hour then close.

maria (oncall): handoff ack. Opening incident ticket.

maria (oncall): ```
Created INC-2026-metric-duplication - https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026
```

samir (billing): root cause: consumer-lib commit 9f3a2b modified checkpoint ordering; will prepare PR to add idempotency guard to checkpoint writer and add unit tests.

leo (sre): also adding a monitor: alert if token_count regression >1% per shard within 5m. Filing monitoring ticket.

maria (oncall): thanks team. I'll write timeline and RCA in the incident ticket. closing chat in 30m unless regression. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: If new regressions appear, this thread will auto-expand and page the oncall rotation. Otherwise we'll mark resolved after monitoring window.

[reactions: many :eyes:, :white_check_mark: on the rollback messages]
